name: Explicit Path Tracing with Russian Roulette
aliases: Path Tracing with Russian Roulette and Material Sampling
definition: A path tracing algorithm that explicitly manages recursion depth and uses Russian Roulette to terminate paths probabilistically based on surface albedo.
summary: Explicit Path Tracing recursively traces rays with fixed depth limits and probabilistic termination based on surface albedo, unlike methods using discrete probabilities for sparse media.
